{{2014–15 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2014–15 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Ohio University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. It was the first year for [[Saul Phillips (basketball)|Saul Phillips]] as head coach for the program. The team played its home games at the [[Convocation Center (Ohio University)|Convocation Center]] in [[Athens, Ohio]] as a member of the [[Mid-American Conference]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ohio.edu/building-directory/convocation-center|title=Convocation Center|website=Ohio University|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/coaches/saul-phillips-1.html|title=Saul Phillips|website=Sports Reference|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2014/04/06/ohio-hires-saul-phillips-as-new-coach/7377639/|title=Ohio hires Saul Phillips as new coach|website=USAToday|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}</ref>  They finished the season 10–20, 5–13 in [[2014–15 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC play]] to finish in last place in the East Division. They lost in the first round of the [[2015 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to Western Michigan.

==Previous season==

{{main|2013–14 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team}}
The Bobcats finished the [[2013–14 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|2013–14]] season 25–12, 11–7 in MAC play to finish in third place in the East Division.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mid-American Standings|url=https://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/standings/conference/MIDAM|publisher=CBSSports.com|accessdate=June 14, 2014}}</ref> They advanced to the quarterfinals of the [[2014 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] where they lost to [[2013–14 Akron Zips men's basketball team|Akron]].<ref>{{cite web |title=No. 4 Akron beats No. 5 Ohio 83-77 in MAC tourney|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400545694|work=ESPN.com|access-date=June 14, 2014}}</ref> They were invited to the [[2014 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Tournament]](CIT) where they defeated [[2013–14 Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team|Cleveland State]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Cleveland State vs Ohio Box Score|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/boxscore?gameId=400546981|work=ESPN.com|access-date=June 14, 2014}}</ref> and [[2013–14 Wright State Raiders men's basketball team|Wright State]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Wright State vs Ohio Box Score|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/boxscore?gameId=400547634|work=ESPN.com|access-date=June 14, 2014}}</ref> to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2013–14 VMI Keydets basketball team|VMI]].<ref>{{cite web |title=VMI vs Ohio Box Score|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/boxscore?gameId=400548954|work=ESPN.com|access-date=June 14, 2014}}</ref>

==Off season==

[[Jim Christian]] resigned from Ohio to coach for the [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College Eagles]] on April 3, 2014.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jim Christian Resigns as Ohio's Head Men's Basketball Coach|url=http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040314aab.html|publisher=ohiobobcats.com|accessdate=June 14, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140413140322/http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040314aab.html|archive-date=April 13, 2014|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref> Ohio University Director of Athletics [[Jim Schaus]] introduced [[Saul Phillips (basketball)|Saul Phillips]] as the new head coach for the Bobcats three days later on April 6, 2014.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ohio Introduces Head Coach Saul Phillips|url=http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040814aaa.html|publisher=ohiobobcats.com|accessdate=June 14, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140413132202/http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040814aaa.html|archive-date=April 13, 2014|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref>

Phillips announced on May 7, 2014 that the coaching staff will include former [[North Dakota State Bison men's basketball|NDSU]] assistants Will Ryan and Jason Kemp. Aaron Fuss(assistant under former head coach Christian) will remain with the Bobcats as an assistant under Phillips as well.<ref>{{cite web|title=Saul Phillips Announces Coaching Staff Additions|url=http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/050714aaa.html|publisher=ohiobobcats.com|accessdate=June 14, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140513023033/http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/050714aaa.html|archive-date=May 13, 2014|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref>

Freshman Jaaron Simmons transferred from the [[2013–14 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|University of Houston]]. Because of NCAA transfer rules, Simmons will be forced to sit out the 2014–15 season but will have 3 years of eligibility starting the following season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ohio Adds Houston Transfer Jaaron Simmons To Roster|url=http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/070114aaa.html|publisher=ohiobobcats.com|accessdate=July 4, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714212713/http://www.ohiobobcats.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/070114aaa.html|archive-date=July 14, 2014|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref>
